feedback: I want to retain the same exact game mechanics and world visuals, but just be able to break blocks and to find reward when breaking these blocks. don't change anything about the game map layout construction, I just want to be able to break blocks

selection.reason: Adding a completely new mechanic (breaking blocks via shooting or interactions, spawning and collecting rewards) requires coordinated changes across state initialization, the update loop, the render loop, and reset logic. A rewrite is best suited for this level of cross-cutting feature addition.
